name: Big Bass Bonanza

features.name: Money symbols
features.description: Fish symbols carry random cash values.

features.name: Free spins with fisherman wilds
features.description: In free spins each fisherman wild collects every fish value on screen. Every fourth wild retriggers spins and raises the collect multiplier (2x, 3x, 10x).

review: Big Bass Bonanza started a series that now has dozens of entries. The base game is a simple ten-line slot, but the free spins collect mechanic is easy to grasp and very watchable: land fish, land a fisherman, collect. The 2,100x cap is low by modern standards, which is part of why the game feels steadier than many high-volatility slots. Its RTP of 96.71% is also one of the higher defaults in Pragmatic's range.
pros: Good entry point to the series
